notes.text:
This update for protobuf fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-4565: Fix parsing of untrusted Protocol Buffers data containing an arbitrary number of recursive groups or messages that can lead to crash due to RecursionError (bsc#1244663).

notes.text: Any project that uses Protobuf Pure-Python backend  to parse untrusted Protocol Buffers data containing an arbitrary number of recursive groups, recursive messages or a series of SGROUP  tags can be corrupted by exceeding the Python recursion limit. This can result in a Denial of service by crashing the application with a RecursionError. We recommend upgrading to version =>6.31.1 or beyond commit  17838beda2943d08b8a9d4df5b68f5f04f26d901
